title: Rebalance shards from 10-shard CI durations
body:
Outcome: the 10-shard plan stops overloading one shard, so the slowest Test step moves toward the shard mean.
Evidence: main runs since 2194438 (42429805266, 42430428146, 42430864780, 42431526060): shard 3 ran 14/18/18/18 s while shards 1 and 5 ran 10-13 s; node scripts/shard-wall-report.mjs --since 2194438 flags 23 files whose median CI duration exceeds their weight by more than 30% (worst test/worker/hardening-baseline.test.ts 13.2 s vs weight 6.8); both models correlate weakly (summed r=0.35, heaviest-lane r=-0.17).
Acceptance: node scripts/shard-weights-refresh.mjs --runs 5 --write over 10-shard main runs only; then 5 main runs since that commit print a slowest Test step p50 below 18 s and fewer drifted files (node scripts/shard-wall-report.mjs --since <refresh sha>).

Note: Pearson r cannot judge a balanced plan (predicted walls 43.4-43.5 summed and 10.9-11.7 lane s barely vary, so r was 0.35 and -0.20 over 5 runs); judge per-shard medians across runs (shard 3 at 18 s in 3 of 5) and the slowest-step p50, or replace the r verdict in scripts/shard-wall-report.mjs with a shard-rank consistency check.

Refresh e9ebc8f (window start): weights from 10-shard main runs 42437333036 42437063331 42436168431 42436014411 42435706998; test/worker/state-trust.test.ts (12.2 s) and test/worker/recovery.test.ts (11.7 s) split under the 11 s file bound with apportioned weights. Baseline over those runs at 1dd36d6 (node scripts/shard-wall-report.mjs --runs 5): slowest Test step p50 17 s, 17 drifted files, shard p50 11-16 s (shard 3 highest). On their per-file medians the old plan summed 23.5-55.5 s per shard (lane wall 9.6-14.6 s), the refreshed plan 42.4-42.5 s (lane wall 10.7-11.8 s). Close when node scripts/shard-wall-report.mjs --since e9ebc8f prints runs: 5 of 5 with a slowest Test step p50 below 18 s and fewer than 17 drifted files.
